finding_key: .github/workflows/agent-iterate-ci.yml::`allowed_bots` may not be a supported input on the pinned claude-code-action commit, in which case it is silently ignored (warning only) and the bot block persists
evidence: The claim is speculative by its own admission: it hinges on `allowed_bots` being absent from claude-code-action at the pinned commit af0559ee (agent-iterate-ci.yml:151, agent-review-panel.yml:404), and the action's action.yml is listed as cited-but-not-supplied, so neither the reviewer nor I could inspect it. `allowed_bots` is a documented v1 input of anthropics/claude-code-action, and the comment added at agent-iterate-ci.yml:155-157 paraphrases the action's own warning that '*' is unsafe on public repos — a warning emitted by the very code path that consumes `allowed_bots`, indicating the author read the pinned implementation. The mechanical premise (Actions only warns on unknown `with:` keys, it does not fail) is accurate, but the condition the finding depends on most likely does not hold, so no defect is present as written; severity would be major if the input truly were absent, since the fix loop would silently never run.
